```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| echo: false
#| include: false

box::use(
  dplyr[mutate],
  glue[glue],
  SeuratObject[LoadSeuratRds],
)
```

## Run Information

```{r}
#| label: run-information
#| echo: false

# Input directory
data_dir <- "../data/Seurat_objects"

# Output directories
run_dir <- glue("run_{format(Sys.time(), '%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M')}")
out_dir <- glue("../output/data/Seurat_objects/{run_dir}")

# Ensure the output directory exists
if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) {
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

message(glue("
📂 Input Seurat objects from: {data_dir}
💾 Outputs will be saved in: {out_dir}
"))
```

## Load Data

```{r}
#| label: load-data-liver1

sobj_l1 <- LoadSeuratRds(file.path(
  data_dir,
  "Seurat_liver1.Rds"
))

sobj_l1
```

```{r}
#| label: load-data-liver2

sobj_l2 <- LoadSeuratRds(file.path(
  data_dir,
  "Seurat_liver2.Rds"
))

sobj_l2
```

## Prepare FOV

Append dataset specific to `fov` in the metadata.
Both liver1 and liver2 dataset have 45 FOVs.

```{r}
#| label: append-suffix-fov

object_ids <- c("liver1", "liver2")

# Add IDs according to Seurat object
sobj_l1@meta.data <- sobj_l1@meta.data |>
  mutate(fov = glue("{fov}_{object_ids[1]}"))

sobj_l2@meta.data <- sobj_l2@meta.data |>
  mutate(fov = glue("{fov}_{object_ids[2]}"))
```

## Merge Objects

Needs to increase memory limit to process. 
`options(future.globals.maxSize = 6000 * 1024^2)`

```{r}
#| label: merge-objects

# Sets limit to ~4,5GB to enable proper computation for large Seurat objects
options(future.globals.maxSize = 6000 * 1024^2)

# Merges the two Seurat objects and adds the provided cell identifiers
sobj_liver_merged <- merge(
  sobj_l1,
  y = sobj_l2,
  add.cell.ids = object_ids
)

# Saves the merged Seurat object
saveRDS(sobj_liver_merged, file = file.path(out_dir, "Seurat_liver_merged.Rds"))

sobj_liver_merged
```

$34452 + 33333 = 67785$
